details.response_text: In August 2026, **<citation-number id="query_0401c4e1" column="pct_not_bookable">69.1</citation-number>%** of calendar nights are not bookable — that's <citation-number id="query_0401c4e1" column="not_available">319,197</citation-number> unavailable nights out of <citation-number id="query_0401c4e1" column="total_nights">461,931</citation-number> total.

args.sql_query:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_nights,
    SUM(CASE WHEN available = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_available,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN available = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_not_bookable
FROM calendar
WHERE date >= '2026-08-01' AND date < '2026-09-01'
args.name: August 2026 - Not Bookable Nights
